class.name: FmodSound
class.brief_description: A sound file playing through FMOD's Core API.
class.description: Returned by [method FmodFile.create_instance]. It keeps its [FmodFile] loaded. Release it once it is no longer needed.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the sound's FMOD channel exists.

method.name: release
method.description: Stops the sound and releases its FMOD channel.

method.name: set_paused
method.description: Pauses the sound if [param paused] is [code]true[/code], and resumes it otherwise.

members.member: The position of the sound in the world, in 3D. Positions are in meters times [member FmodSettings.distance_factor_3d], like the 3D nodes of the extension. Setting it, or any of the position and velocity properties, makes the sound 3D, so FMOD spatializes it against the listeners.

The position of the sound in the world, in 2D, in pixels, converted with [member FmodSettings.distance_factor_2d] and the 2D mapping the 2D nodes of the extension use. It is the same position as [member position_3d], seen on a plane.
The pitch multiplier of the sound: 1 is the original pitch, 2 an octave higher.
The velocity of the sound in 3D, in position units per second, used for the Doppler effect. FMOD does not move the sound by it: update [member position_3d] yourself.
The velocity of the sound in 2D, in pixels per second, with the 2D mapping of [member position_2d].
The volume multiplier of the sound: 1 is the original volume, 0 silent.
